# EgoAgent

> AI to help your therapist help you.

Your session, thought through again by your therapist, with AI.

## For patients

- Free for you. Your therapist subscribes.
- Processed and stored securely. Never used to train AI.
- Informed consent: Written and HIPAA-compliant. Withdraw at any time.

## For therapists

- The patient leaves. Something stays behind to be understood. Bring it here.
- One session, or the whole treatment.
- Another perspective, not another authority.
- Beyond a professional boundary, the working space opens only to verified clinicians.

## Pages

- [For patients](https://egoagent.ai/): what EgoAgent is, and the patient's choice.
- [For therapists](https://egoagent.ai/#therapists): how a therapist uses it.

The clinician workspace is private and is not for automated reading.
